field_evidence.api_semantics: Planning Data official API documentation states that entity.json accepts a WKT geometry parameter plus geometry_relation to return entities whose geometries interact with the supplied area; coordinates are WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
field_evidence.dataset_semantics: The official Title boundary dataset represents HM Land Registry title-boundary/index polygons showing the position and indicative extent of registered property.
field_evidence.target_window: The unused request window is a small WGS84 polygon around the verified Forge Cottage producer building outline: POLYGON((0.9099 51.0733,0.9105 51.0733,0.9105 51.0737,0.9099 51.0737,0.9099 51.0733)).
field_evidence.record_cap: The official API request is capped at limit=50 in accordance with the batch contract.
field_evidence.transport_result: The official custom entity.json geometry/intersects URL could not be retrieved by the available web transport; no response payload, title-boundary entity ID/reference, geometry or bbox was obtained.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Because the target-scoped API payload was not obtained, no candidate title-boundary is asserted and no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted. Spatial binding/materialization remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. An unused official Planning Data raw geometry/intersects query was scoped to a small WGS84 polygon around the verified Forge Cottage producer outline and capped at 50 title-boundary records, but the custom entity.json URL could not be retrieved through the available transport, so no target title-boundary entity/reference, polygon or bbox was obtained. Local OpenCode/browser-capable retrieval must run this or another target-scoped official query and bind the exact title-boundary record; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from dataset-level title-boundary source-area inventory to a target-scoped raw WKT geometry/intersects API query. The official Planning Data documentation supports this query form and the request was limited to 50 records, but this transport could not retrieve the custom entity.json response. No candidate polygon is inferred from the request geometry, no canonical parcel ID/geometry/bbox is asserted, and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
